prompt: Paint this scene anew from higher above, a steeper view like the game's own camera, so the courtyards and the tile grid show plainly: a green land map, the left castle lower left, the right castle upper right, a river between them, round trees and rocks. The two castles are the same painted style and not mirror images: the left castle has a tall square keep with the lookout tower and the red flag, a gatehouse and three small houses; the right castle has a lower keep, a round corner tower with the blue flag, a long barn and two houses; their walls differ in length. Cannons: each castle has exactly two bronze cannons, each a complete barrel on a wooden carriage with two wheels, standing on the flat stone top of a corner tower on the side that faces the other castle, so the barrel looks out over the battlements straight at the other castle; the cannons stand on stone, never on a roof, never over a house, never in a wall. No cannon fires yet, no smoke, no cannonball. The tile grid is painted in the same perspective as the castles: its lines run parallel to the castle walls and its squares foreshorten exactly like the courtyards. The title Grid Cannons in the same white hand-lettered script as the attached image, large, on the sky at the top, covering nothing. Soft painterly 2D illustration, soft colours, not oversaturated, a cream sky fade at the top. No people, no other words, no watermark.
label: 5-land-top-down-scene--nanobanana
